changes.title: Potion effect attribution
changes.text: Keep thrown potion effects attributed while treating triggered terrain traps as environmental.

changes.title: Potion cloud origin
changes.text: Retain known potion ownership when creating corrosive clouds.

changes.title: Caustic brew ownership
changes.text: Preserve the thrower of caustic-brew effects across saves.

changes.title: Nested effect safety
changes.text: Restore effect attribution after nested effects and exceptions without retaining actor references.

changes.title: Caustic effect source
changes.text: Allow caustic effects to record a known creator without changing an existing effect on invalid input.

changes.title: Throw callback ownership
changes.text: Capture offensive ownership when a throw begins, without relying on a later current-user value.

changes.title: Throw and trap regressions
changes.text: Test real caustic effects, persisted ownership, environmental traps and exception cleanup.

changes.title: Throw verification record
changes.text: Document throw-boundary checks and remaining damage-source work.

changes.title: Development checkpoint
changes.text: Preserve verified source evidence and the unfinished damage-slider checkpoint.

changes.title: Score scrolling verification
changes.text: Require an overflowing small-window fixture before testing native touchscreen scrolling.

changes.title: TEST136 verification record
changes.text: Record the passing core build and failed native score-scrolling check.

changes.title: Private build checks
changes.text: Require full source and Android checks for the next private candidate.

changes.title: Complete history validation
changes.text: Require the build-history ledger itself to be included in the reviewed changes.
